2026-11-20ISEDWeights and Measures ActOrder Amending Schedule IV to the Weights and Measures ActOrder Amending Schedule IV to the Weights and Measures Act in order to (1) remove three obsolete reference standards, two for the measurement of mass or weight (MR-2 and MR-3) and one for the measurement of temperature (VS767_1203); and (2) add three new reference standards (E1966, E1967, and EL-1988) for electricity and another reference standard (VS1223_5798) for the measurement of temperature so that they could be used for the evaluation of devices for the purposes of issuing a type approval notice.N/A
subject: Order Amending Schedule IV to the Weights and Measures Act
precis: Order Amending Schedule IV to the Weights and Measures Act in order to (1) remove three obsolete reference standards, two for the measurement of mass or weight (MR-2 and MR-3) and one for the measurement of temperature (VS767_1203); and (2) add three new reference standards (E1966, E1967, and EL-1988) for electricity and another reference standard (VS1223_5798) for the measurement of temperature so that they could be used for the evaluation of devices for the purposes of issuing a type approval notice.
